def VTask.greatestOfBdd {P : ℤ → Prop} [DecidablePred P] (b : ℤ) (Hb : ∀ z, P z → z ≤ b) (Hinh : ∃ z, P z) : { ub // P ub ∧ ∀ (z : ℤ), P z → z ≤ ub } :=
  let h_start : ∃ w ≤ b, P w := by
    obtain ⟨z, hPz⟩ := Hinh
    exact ⟨z, (Hb z hPz).le⟩
  let h_no_larger_initial : ∀ z'', b < z'' ≤ b → ¬P z'' := by
    intro z'' h1 h2
    cases lt_irrefl b (lt_of_lt_of_le h1 h2)
  let rec find_max (z : ℤ) (h_exists : ∃ w ≤ z, P w) (h_no_larger : ∀ z'', z < z'' ≤ b → ¬P z'') : { ub // P ub ∧ ∀ z', P z' → z' ≤ ub } :=
    have h_z_le_b : z ≤ b := by
      obtain ⟨w, h_w_le_z, hPw⟩ := h_exists
      exact le_trans h_w_le_z (Hb w hPw)
    if hP : P z then
      have hP_z : P z := hP
      have h_max : ∀ z', P z' → z' ≤ z := by
        intro z' hP'
        contrapose!
        intro h_gt
        have h_z'_le_b : z' ≤ b := Hb z' hP'
        have h_range : z < z' ∧ z' ≤ b := by
          split
          exact h_gt
          exact h_z'_le_b
        exact (h_no_larger z' h_range.1 h_range.2) hP'
      ⟨z, hP_z, h_max⟩
    else
      obtain ⟨w, h_w_le_z_minus_1, hPw⟩ := by
        obtain ⟨w, h_w_le_z, hPw⟩ := h_exists
        have h_w_ne_z : w ≠ z := by
          intro h_eq
          rw [h_eq] at hPw
          exact hP hPw
        have h_w_lt_z : w < z := by
          linarith [h_w_le_z, h_w_ne_z]
        have h_w_le_z_minus_1 : w ≤ z - 1 := by
          exact le_sub_one_of_lt h_w_lt_z
        exact ⟨w, h_w_le_z_minus_1, hPw⟩
      let h_no_larger' : ∀ z'', (z - 1 < z'') → z'' ≤ b → ¬P z'' := by
        intro z'' h_gt h_le
        cases le_or_gt z'' z with
        | inl h_le_z => 
          have h_eq : z'' = z := by
            have h_z''_ge : z'' ≥ z := by linarith [h_gt, h_le_z]
            linarith
          rw [h_eq]
          exact mt (λ h => h) hP
        | inr h_gt_z => 
          exact h_no_larger z'' h_gt_z h_le
      find_max (z - 1) ⟨w, h_w_le_z_minus_1, hPw⟩ h_no_larger'
    using_well_founded { rel_tac := λ _ _ => `[exact measure (λ _ => b - z)] }
